S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  04.11.2025 C528 No. 1946 of 2025  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

This Application has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Complaint Case No. 375 of 2024, pending before the Court of Judicial Magistrate / Ist Additional Civil Judge, Roorkee, District Haridwar under Sections 498A, 323, 504 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 3 and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

entities.text: Court of Judicial Magistrate / Ist Additional Civil Judge, Roorkee, District Haridwar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard Mr. Akshay Pradhan, learned counsel for the applicants.
3. The applicant no.1 is the elder brother of the husband of the respondent- complainant.
The applicant no.2 is the wife of the applicant no.1 and the applicant no.3 is the mother of the applicant no.1.
4. Mr. Akshay Pradhan, Advocate, contended that there are no specific or direct allegations against the present applicants.
Applicants are permanent residents of District Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh.
The mandatory inquiry under Section 202 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has not been conducted by the Magistrate prior to issuance of summons to the applicants.
5. Notice is being issued to the respondent.
Steps to be taken within three days.
Till then, the further proceedings of the said Complaint Case No. 375 of 2024 are stayed qua the applicants.
7. The applicant no.1 and the respondent are directed to appear in-person before this Court on 17.12.2025.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 04.11.2025 Shiv/
